reason: A desktop integration plugin that adds an Electron shell, system tray, native window controls, and optional shortcuts around the official DeepSeek Harness WebUI.

summaries.zh: 为官方 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 提供基于 Electron 的桌面外壳、系统托盘、原生窗口控制和可选快捷入口。
summaries.en: Adds an Electron desktop shell, system tray integration, native window controls, and optional shortcuts around the official DeepSeek Harness WebUI.

capabilities: Wraps the official DeepSeek Harness WebUI in an Electron desktop window
Provides system tray controls and native window behavior
Creates optional desktop and application-menu shortcuts
Downloads and extracts the platform-specific Electron runtime
